title: BPW-2026-0545
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0545
BOS + BCA
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP) AND NEGOTIATE CONTRACT(S) – GREEN ACRES FARM (GAF)
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation to:
DISTRIBUTE and ADVERTISE the transmitted RFP for the Management of the City’s Biosolids at the City’s GAF;
EVALUATE the proposals, select, and interview the most qualified proposer(s) based on established rating criteria;
NEGOTIATE a contract(s) with the most responsive proposer(s); and
RETURN to the Board of Public Works for authority to award and execute any contract(s), subject to Mayor and City Council approval prior to contract execution.
(W.O.: S10FPURC)
summary: The Board of Public Works will authorize the Bureau of Sanitation to advertise a request for proposals for managing the city's biosolids at Green Acres Farm, then evaluate proposals and negotiate contracts, returning to the board for final award.

details.action: Advertise RFP, evaluate proposals and negotiate contracts for biosolids management
